chief_decision: v2 40cm SD7080 3-blade fixed-pitch upwind rotor with soft stall on rigid hub drives direct-drive 170-180Kv outrunner plus Schottky bridge in stiff two-bearing nacelle on steel post clamp inside 45cm cube with post below; buck-boost feed to tunnel load plus switched 4ohm dump grid; series Normally Closed e-stop plus load-volt tap plus centrifugal overspeed switch latching trip drives spring-applied 0.80N-m disc plus dump brake with wiring inside nacelle and post bore.
